0.name: Ghost Fishing Net (Entanglement Danger)
0.diver_safety: Approach with extreme care. Carry line-cutting shears; avoid loose gear that can snare.
0.marine_risk: Continuous ghost-fishing; strangles sea turtles, cetaceans, and destroys coral outcrops.

1.name: Subsea Fuel Pipeline (Infrastructure Collision)
1.diver_safety: Do not anchor or drop clump weights. Verify cathodic protection without striking pipeline.
1.marine_risk: Catastrophic hydrocarbon spill risk; toxicity to benthic benthic flora and fish breeding grounds.

2.name: Sunken Vessel Debris / Uncharted Wreck
2.diver_safety: Watch for sharp hull edges, unstable structural collapses, and entanglement in loose rigging.
2.marine_risk: Heavy fuel oil entrapment; alters natural local tidal sediment drift vectors.

3.name: Clear Benthic Seabed / Normal Sediment
3.diver_safety: Standard dive buddy procedures; verify isobaric acoustic bottom lock.
